programme.title: Giri
programme.desc: Two feuding landlords struggle to destroy each other. When one of them loses his son, he vows to kill the son of his rival. The boy, however, manages to escape only to return 20 years later.

programme.title: Ramana
programme.desc: Ramana, a professor, heads a secret force that eliminates corruption from society. They kidnap fifteen most corrupt employees from each government department and kill the most unscrupulous one.

programme.title: Darling
programme.desc: Depressed in life, three youngsters decide to commit suicide and go to a beach house to do it, unaware that the place is haunted by a ghost.

programme.title: Amarkalam
programme.desc: Vasu, an unruly man, fights with Mohana, the daughter of a police officer, over a movie reel. Thereafter, the two fall in love but face unforeseen problems while they try to unite.

programme.title: Manasu
programme.desc: Relax and unwind with this entertaining movie starring Sakthi and Oviya.

programme.title: Markandeyan
programme.desc: Vittal is a milk vendor who adopts orphans and trains them to become criminals. When Mark, one of his adopted sons falls in love with Divya, he wants to put an end to it.

programme.title: Songs
programme.desc: Stay tuned to this sequence of interesting songs.

programme.title: Thunichal
programme.desc: An innocent woman finds herself being followed by an obsessive lover who threatens to harm or even kill her after she rejects his advantages.

programme.title: Dhinandhorum
programme.desc: An unemployed man spends all his time with his girlfriend and enjoys his life to the fullest. However, because of this, he is not deemed to be a suitable groom for the girl by her father.

programme.title: Vaanavil
programme.desc: Surya, Prakash and Priya are three IAS aspirants. When Surya and Priya fall in love, Prakash, Priya's secret admirer, silently becomes an enemy posing as a friend and plots to get rid of Surya.

programme.title: Chinna Mappillai
programme.desc: Thangadurai, who works as a coolie, lies to Janaki that he is rich and marries her. However, when Janaki's mother learns this, she plots to destroy their marriage but succumbs to their love.

programme.title: Gajendra
programme.desc: Gajendra, an orphan, is brought up by his wealthy master and soon is to marry the latter's granddaughter. However, he also has a soft corner for a mentally deranged girl for reasons best known to him.

programme.title: Marumagale Vaazhga
